Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Concentric dark rings and yellowing margins on lower leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Ensure good spacing for aeration; water at ground level to keep foliage dry.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply a copper-based biological fungicide or neem oil spray every 7 days.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large, dark, water-soaked brown lesions on leaves and stems with white fungal mold underneath.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation; eliminate volunteer potato and tomato plants.
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Prune and destroy infected leaves immediately; apply bio-fungicide protective sprays.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, dark, greasy spots with yellow halos across leaves and stems.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds and maintain crop rotation cycles.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply fixed-copper bactericides mixed with mancozeb to reduce spread.

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant green foliage with no discoloration or lesions.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Maintain regular watering and balanced nitrogen-phosphorus fertilization.
Tomato___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. The crop is healthy.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Target-like circular brown lesions on older leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops with non-solanaceous plants every 3 years.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Spray chlorothalonil or copper sulfate preventative mixtures.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Purplish-brown lesions surrounded by pale green borders.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified resistant seed tubers; avoid damp, waterlogged fields.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Prune blighted foliage and apply systemic fungicides promptly.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Sturdy foliage with uniform green pigmentation.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Keep soil well-drained and maintain proper tuber hilling.
